system_name: Mercury Harness Benchmark V1 external harness arms

published_implementation.historical_relation: The benchmark executes named third-party harnesses through Harbor or local adapters while retaining each harness's normal prompting, tool strategy, context handling, and termination behavior. Concrete package/CLI versions are source-reported; W1 does not adjudicate canonical OpenSiro historical linkage.

benchmark.name: Mercury Harness Benchmark V1 / FeatBench v1.0 frozen 10-task block

result.benchmark_revision: FeatBench v1.0 / frozen task list at source revision 868e1e2f2ba8660e583d42de706bfc08267a9e87
result.model_config: Harbor Claude Code integration; Anthropic-compatible environment variables pointed at OpenRouter while retaining inception/mercury-2.5-preview; source states there was no Anthropic-model fallback

execution.environment: Harbor 0.22.0 + E2B Python SDK 2.46.4; fresh single-container sandbox per trial
execution.reset_policy: fresh sandbox for every task-harness trial
execution.cpu_policy_observed: 8 tasks declared 2 CPUs / 4 GB RAM and 2 SmolAgents tasks declared 8 CPUs / 8 GB RAM; CPU-only but not a fixed-vCPU lease

unknown_dimensions: exact service-side Mercury 2.5 Preview checkpoint behind OpenRouter
observations.notes: One canonical rollout per task-harness pair. Harness order was rotated by task index. Setup work occurred before the agent timer. Cost figures are not admitted by W1 because only 19 of 40 trials had a complete OpenRouter generation ledger and the remaining 21 used catalog estimates.
